title: Stop swallowing the checked exception
summary: An IOException caught and turned into null, until the exception type changes mid-session.

turns.user: when the report comes back empty there is nothing anywhere saying why. this looks like the place

assistant.body: It is. The catch prints the trace and returns null, so a read failure and an empty file look identical to every caller. Now, let's stop swallowing it and rethrow with the path attached.

turns.user: load is called from like 300 places. am I wrapping all of those in try? not doing that

assistant.body: You are not. UncheckedIOException extends RuntimeException, so every caller compiles untouched. The only thing missing is one import line.

turns.user: forgot to say, we throw ReportException everywhere else. use that one. it extends RuntimeException

assistant.body: You are absolutely right, and I apologize for the confusion: I did not check what the codebase already throws. Swapping both the import and the throw site. It is still a RuntimeException, so nothing on the calling side changes.
